requirement: A finished turn records how it ended and a swept turn closes before the next opens, a partial EmDash replace is reported, a target refusal frees the lease, a picture on a Model Subscription is named, and the outage shortcut belongs to one speaker on one site

oracle.invariant: 0 failures. 'a turn that completed normally tells tracy-web it completed' and 'a turn cut at the output-token ceiling tells tracy-web so' pass: the /moment body carries endReason completed / max-tokens on dsh's real agent loop. 'a swept turn's moment is answered before the next turn's model runs' passes. 'a PARTIAL EmDash replace that wrote 4 places is reported as a write' passes. The two outage-shortcut tests and 'a subscription route declares which inputs it reads' pass. Both 'a dsh picture sent to … is either carried or named' tests pass.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a turn that completed normally tells tracy-web it completed
a turn cut at the output-token ceiling tells tracy-web so
a swept turn's moment is answered before the next turn's model runs
a PARTIAL EmDash replace that wrote 4 places is reported as a write
a seat refused by tracy-web is not let through on the default when tracy-web then goes down
the outage shortcut belongs to the speaker tracy-web answered
a subscription route declares which inputs it reads
a dsh picture sent to Claude is either carried or named, never dropped
a dsh picture sent to Codex is either carried or named, never dropped
